question: Pramila Malik was in news to become the first woman Speaker of which state assembly in September 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pramila Malik** became the first woman Speaker of the Odisha state assembly in September 2023.
 
• Her appointment marks a significant milestone in the state's legislative history.
 
• Pramila Malik has been an active political figure and has contributed to various social and political causes in Odisha.
 
• Her role as Speaker will involve presiding over assembly sessions, maintaining decorum, and ensuring the smooth conduct of legislative business.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Speaker of a state assembly is a crucial position, responsible for the functioning of the legislative assembly.
 
• The Speaker's duties include deciding on points of order, ensuring the rules of procedure are followed, and representing the assembly in its relations with the governor and other authorities.
 
• Odisha, located on the eastern coast of India, has a rich cultural heritage and is known for its temples, beaches, and tribal cultures.
 
• The state assembly of Odisha is unicameral, consisting of a single house with 147 elected members.
